body.promptVi: Viết 4 câu kể về ngày hôm qua của bạn: bạn đã làm gì vào buổi sáng, buổi chiều và buổi tối?
modelAnswers: Yesterday I got up early. In the morning I went to work by bus. In the afternoon I had a meeting. In the evening I cooked dinner and watched a movie.
I didn't work yesterday. I visited my grandparents in the morning. We had lunch together. In the evening I went to bed at ten.

body.promptVi: Viết 4 câu về thói quen của bạn (dùng always, usually, sometimes, never).
modelAnswers: I always have breakfast at home. I usually go to work by motorbike. I sometimes cook dinner for my family. I never drink coffee in the evening.
I always brush my teeth before bed. I usually read for twenty minutes. I sometimes go jogging in the park. I never go to bed after midnight.

body.promptVi: Viết 4 câu dự đoán về tương lai của bạn trong 5 năm tới (dùng "will").
modelAnswers: In five years I will speak English well. I will have a better job. I think I will live in a bigger apartment. Maybe I will travel to another country.
I think I will finish my studies in two years. I will find a job in a big company. I won't live with my parents. I will probably buy a car.

body.promptVi: Viết 4 câu về điều sẽ xảy ra nếu… (dùng câu điều kiện loại 1).
modelAnswers: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home. If I have free time, I will call my friends. If I study hard, I will pass the exam. If I pass the exam, my parents will be happy.
If I wake up early, I will go running. If the weather is nice, we will have a picnic. If I save money, I will buy a new laptop. If I'm tired tonight, I won't go out.

body.promptVi: Viết 4 câu về kỳ nghỉ gần nhất của bạn: bạn đã đi đâu, với ai, và bạn thấy thế nào?
modelAnswers: Last summer I went to Nha Trang with my family. We stayed in a small hotel near the beach. We swam every day. It was a wonderful holiday.
Last month I traveled to Da Lat with two friends. The weather was cool and the flowers were beautiful. We ate a lot of local food. I really enjoyed the trip.

body.promptVi: Viết 4 câu về kế hoạch cuối tuần tới của bạn (dùng "be going to").
modelAnswers: Next weekend I am going to visit my parents. On Saturday we are going to cook a big dinner. On Sunday I am going to clean my apartment. In the evening I am going to relax.
This weekend I'm going to meet my friends. We're going to see a new movie. After that we're going to have pizza. On Sunday I'm going to stay at home and read.

body.promptVi: Viết một email ngắn (4 câu) mời một người bạn đến dự sinh nhật của bạn.
modelAnswers: Hi Lan, my birthday party is on Saturday evening. It starts at seven at my house. There will be food, music and games. I hope you can come!
Dear Minh, I'm having a small birthday party next Friday. We're going to have dinner at a restaurant near the river. Please come at six thirty. Let me know if you can come.

body.promptVi: Viết 4 câu so sánh thành phố của bạn với một thành phố khác (dùng dạng so sánh hơn).
modelAnswers: Hanoi is older than Ho Chi Minh City. Ho Chi Minh City is bigger and busier. The weather in Hanoi is colder in winter. I think the food in both cities is delicious.
My town is smaller than Da Nang. It is quieter and cheaper. Da Nang has more beaches and better hospitals. But I prefer my town because my family lives there.

body.promptVi: Viết 4 câu về những việc bạn đã từng làm và chưa từng làm (dùng thì hiện tại hoàn thành).
modelAnswers: I have visited three countries. I have eaten sushi in Japan. I have never been to Europe. I have never ridden a horse.
I have lived in this city for five years. I have tried many kinds of street food. I have never seen snow. I haven't learned to swim yet.

body.promptVi: Viết 4 câu khuyên một người bạn đang bị cảm (dùng "should" và "shouldn't").
modelAnswers: You should stay at home and rest. You should drink a lot of warm water. You shouldn't go out in the rain. If you feel worse, you should see a doctor.
You should go to bed early tonight. You should eat some hot soup. You shouldn't drink cold drinks. You should take some medicine.

body.promptVi: Viết 4 câu về nội quy ở nơi bạn làm việc hoặc học tập (dùng "must", "mustn't" hoặc "have to").
modelAnswers: At my office we have to start work at eight. We must wear a name card. We mustn't eat at our desks. We have to turn off the lights before we leave.
At my school students must wear a uniform. We have to arrive before seven thirty. We mustn't use phones in class. We have to do our homework every day.

body.promptVi: Viết 4 câu kể chuyện gì đang xảy ra khi bạn về đến nhà tối qua (dùng thì quá khứ tiếp diễn).
modelAnswers: When I got home last night, my mother was cooking dinner. My father was reading the news on his phone. My little brother was playing a game. Our cat was sleeping on the sofa.
When I arrived home, it was raining heavily. My wife was watching TV. My children were doing their homework. Nobody was listening to music.
